question: SHG - Bank Linkage Programme (SHG-BLP) is a bank-led microfinance channel in India, which was initiated by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NABARD.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD):

 
 
• India's top development bank, NABARD, aims to support fair and sustainable rural and agricultural development.
 
• The Sivaraman Committee, which was constituted on March 30, 1979, recommended the establishment of NABARD.
 
• As per the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act, 1981, it is a statutory body that was founded in 1982 by Parliament.
 
• Its headquarter is located in Mumbai, India.
 
• It supervises Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Cooperative Banks, assisting them in establishing safe banking procedures and integrating them with the CBS (Core Banking Solution) system.
 
• Chairman: Shri. Shaji K V
 
• It was established with the aim of providing** credit flow **for the development of** agriculture, cottage and village industries, handicrafts, and small-scale industries** in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Self Help Group - Bank Linkage Programme (SHG-BLP):**
 
 
• It is the **world's largest microfinance initiative initiated by NABARD in 1992** and has since been growing.
 
• It was started to** provide financial assistance to self-help groups (SHGs) through banks** with the objective** to promote financial inclusion and empower women through microfinance.**
 
• Banks were permitted to open savings accounts for SHGs under this policy.
 
• **Components of SHG-BPL:**
 
 
• Bank Branch Managers: Education and Sensitization
 
• Bank Sakhis' orientation and training at rural bank branches
 
• Community Based Repayment Mechanism (CBRM) should be implemented in rural bank branches.
 
• SHG Credit Linkage
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Export-Import (**EXIM)** Bank:**

 
 
• It is a **specialized financial institution in India that was established in 1982.**
 
• The bank's primary function is to finance, facilitate and promote India's international trade.
 
• It is a **statutory body.**
 
• It is **owned by the Government of India** and its operations are governed by the **Export-Import Bank of India Act, 1981.**
 
• Exim Bank provides a wide range of financial services to Indian exporters and importers. These services include export credit, pre-shipment credit, post-shipment credit, and overseas investment finance.
 
• **Headquarter: Mumbai**
 
 
 
• ** Life Insurance Corporation (LIC):**
 
 
• It is** owned by the Indian government, and the Ministry of Finance is in charge of its administration.**
 
• **It is a statutory body.**
 
• **On September 1, 1956, the Life Insurance of India Act, which nationalised the insurance sector** in India, was approved by the Indian Parliament, creating the Life Insurance Corporation of India. 
 
• It is the biggest institutional investment and insurance company in India.
 
• LIC provides life** insurance and pension** products to individuals.
 
• **Headquarter: Mumbai**
 
 
 
• **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI):**
 
 
• It is the **supreme regulatory agency for general licencing and oversight of micro, small, and medium enterprise finance organisations in India**.
 
• It is **governed by the Ministry of Finance** of the Government of India, which has offices around the nation.
 
• It is a statutory body.
 
• The Government of India **founded the SIDBI on April 2, 1990**, and it is a fully owned subsidiary of IDBI Bank. With effect from March 27, 2000, it was disconnected from IDBI. 
 
• **Headquarter: Lucknow**
